## AI that doesn't depend on a connection

### No cloud, no outage

Cloud AI dies the moment the signal does. PortableMind runs on the machine in front of you, on a plane, off-grid, or in the middle of an outage.

### Private by default

Your conversations, documents, and voice never leave your hardware. No telemetry, no uploads, no account to create.

### Pay once, own it

One USB, one payment. No subscription to cancel, no model quietly nerfed. It keeps working whether or not you ever update again.

## Voice, vision, and a real desktop app

Firmware 1.8.0 ships a massively advanced SCOUT Vision: seven field scan modes (General, Plant ID, Mushroom, Bug, Tracks, First Aid, Read Text), each returning a structured triage card with key markers, dangerous lookalikes, confidence ratings, and safety-first verdicts. The whole runtime also got faster, uses your hardware more fully, and adapts to your machine in real time. All local, all private.

### SCOUT Field Modes

SCOUT is no longer one generic vision box. Pick a dedicated scan mode, General, Plant ID, Mushroom, Bug, Tracks, First Aid, or Read Text, and get an answer structured for that exact job, entirely offline.

### Fine-Tuned Vision

The vision stack behind SCOUT got a major fine-tuning pass. Identifications are sharper and every scan states its confidence plainly, with an explicit "if this ID is wrong" risk line so you always know the stakes.

### Faster Performance

A performance pass across the whole runtime. Chat, voice, and SCOUT all respond faster, model loads and switches are snappier, and the app feels lighter on the same hardware you already own.

### Better Utilization + Smart Adaptation

The runtime now makes fuller use of the VRAM and CPU you actually have, and continuously adapts model routing, context sizing, and workload placement to your machine and what you're doing, no config needed.

### Bug-Squashing Pass

A deep stability sweep across the codebase. Crash fixes, leak fixes, and cleaner error recovery in chat, voice, and SCOUT, so the runtime shrugs off the edge cases that used to trip it up.

### Everything from 1.7

Model Manager, the Qwen 3.5 roster, multi-modal chat, GPU-accelerated voice, Phone Access, thread history, AES-hardened import/export, and the offline Field Manual all remain intact. Nothing was removed to make room.

### Built-in field manual

Six categories of grid-down reference ship on every drive, browsable offline with zero AI calls. Tap Ask AI about this when you want the model to walk you through your exact situation.

Want a permanent desk setup? The Survival Terminal is the same offline brain, hand-built into a dedicated box. Released in small runs.
